name: branding-mountain-photo-with-line-a-mark-and-appointment-wordmark
title: White geometric 'A.' and 'appointment' wordmark over a darkened mountain range
whatItIs: A darkened alpine photo with a small figure on a ridge. A large white geometric A with a full stop sits above a lowercase wordmark where the As are open triangles and the m has peaked strokes, with a small Ukrainian tagline on the left.
whatItMeans: Grounded and aspirational; the triangular letters echo peaks.
techniques: Shape letters to echo the imagery (peaks).
Overlay pure white type on a dimmed landscape.
Pair a monogram with a full wordmark.
Include a tiny figure for scale.

vocabulary.definition: A letter shaped like a mountain.
Type placed over a scenic photo.
